findings.title: Reader thread not joined before asserting; exceptions can be missed
findings.body: The test sets `deletedAll` and immediately asserts `caughtExceptions` is empty. It never joins the reader thread, so a request still in flight when the flag flips can fail after the assertion has already passed. If the reader thread never got scheduled before deletion finished, the test also verifies nothing. The thread is never stopped on failure and may outlive the test, hitting the realm during cleanup. Fix: join the thread (with a timeout) before asserting, and ensure at least one read actually ran concurrently with the deletes.

findings.title: Sibling subgroup methods still NPE when group was deleted concurrently
findings.body: `getSubGroupsCount` now null-checks `modelSupplier.get()`. The three `getSubGroupsStream(...)` overloads (lines 256, 262, 268) still call `modelSupplier.get()` directly. If the group was deleted concurrently, the supplier returns null and these throw the same NPE this PR is meant to fix.

findings.title: getSubGroupsCount returns null for deleted group
findings.body: When the group has been removed, `getSubGroupsCount` now returns `null` as a `Long`. Any caller that unboxes the result to `long`, or does arithmetic or comparison on it, will throw an NPE instead. `GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount` is safe because it stores the value, but other callers may not be. Consider returning 0, or documenting the nullable return.
